meta.title: Starlight 预备级 · 前三单元复习

sentences.en: Hello! How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好！你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Hello, what's your name?
sentences.zh: 你好，你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: My name is Abby.
sentences.zh: 我叫Abby。

sentences.en: How are you, my friend?
sentences.zh: 你好吗，我的朋友？

frames.hint: 别人问 How are you?，你怎么回答？

sentences.en: Hello! I'm Sam, a little cat.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是小猫咪 Sam。

sentences.en: It's a new day and the sun is up.
sentences.zh: 新的一天，太阳公公起来啦。

sentences.en: I walk out to play.
sentences.zh: 我出门玩喽。

sentences.en: Hello! My name is Sam. Can I play with you?
sentences.zh: 你好！我叫 Sam，我可以和你一起玩吗？

sentences.en: "Hello, Sam! Great! You can play with me," says the bird.
sentences.zh: “你好呀，Sam！太好了！跟我一起玩吧。”小鸟说。

sentences.en: The bird is small and red.
sentences.zh: 这只小鸟小小的、红红的。

sentences.en: We are happy friends now.
sentences.zh: 现在我们是一对好朋友啦。

sentences.en: We play and play all day.
sentences.zh: 我们玩呀玩，玩了一整天。

sentences.en: We run and jump and sing, too.
sentences.zh: 还一起跑、一起跳、一起唱歌。

sentences.en: The sun goes down. It is evening.
sentences.zh: 太阳落山了，到傍晚啦。

sentences.en: "Good bye, my friend!" I say.
sentences.zh: “再见啦，我的朋友！”我说。

sentences.en: Hello, tomorrow! We will play again.
sentences.zh: 你好呀，明天！我们还要一起玩哦。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you, my friend!
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你，我的朋友！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Perfect! Let us say hello to everybody!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我们跟每个人都说声你好吧！

songs.en: Tra la la la la la la.

sentences.en: Good morning!
sentences.zh: 早上好！

sentences.en: Good afternoon!
sentences.zh: 下午好！

sentences.en: Good evening!
sentences.zh: 晚上好！

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm great!
sentences.zh: 我很好！

sentences.en: Good morning! The sun is up.
sentences.zh: 早上好！太阳公公起来啦。

sentences.en: Good morning, Mom! Hello, new day!
sentences.zh: 早上好，妈妈！你好呀，新的一天！

sentences.en: My mom smiles and says hello to me.
sentences.zh: 妈妈笑着对我说了声你好。

sentences.en: We eat breakfast with my little cat.
sentences.zh: 我们和小猫咪一起吃早饭。

sentences.en: Good afternoon! The sun is high.
sentences.zh: 下午好！太阳爬得高高的。

sentences.en: We play with my cat and my dog.
sentences.zh: 我们和小猫小狗一起玩。

sentences.en: We run and jump in the sun.
sentences.zh: 我们在太阳底下跑呀跳呀。

sentences.en: What a happy day!
sentences.zh: 多么开心的一天呀！

sentences.en: Good evening! The moon is out.
sentences.zh: 晚上好！月亮悄悄爬出来了。

sentences.en: The little stars say hello too.
sentences.zh: 小星星们也在对我说你好呢。

sentences.en: "Good night, moon. Good night, stars."
sentences.zh: “晚安，月亮。晚安，星星。”

sentences.en: Hello, tomorrow! I can not wait.
sentences.zh: 你好呀，明天！我已经等不及啦。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: It is morning now. The sun is up!
dialogue.zh: 现在是早上，太阳升起啦！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: And in the evening... Good evening!

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.zh: 早上！下午！晚上！加快速度！

sentences.en: Who's missing?
sentences.zh: 谁不见了？

sentences.en: Boy or girl?
sentences.zh: 男孩还是女孩？

sentences.en: How many boys?
sentences.zh: 有几个男孩？

sentences.en: Two boys!
sentences.zh: 两个男孩！

sentences.en: Look at the mirror.
sentences.zh: 看镜子。

frames.hint: 指着一样东西，说出它的名字

sentences.en: Look at me! I am Ben, a boy.
sentences.zh: 看看我！我是男孩 Ben。

sentences.en: My friend and I play a mirror game.
sentences.zh: 我和好朋友玩照镜子的游戏。

sentences.en: This morning I stand before my mirror.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我站到了镜子前面。

sentences.en: The mirror is clean. I see one boy.
sentences.zh: 镜子擦得干干净净。我看见一个男孩。

sentences.en: "Who's missing?" I ask my mom.
sentences.zh: “谁不见了？”我问妈妈。

sentences.en: "Look at the mirror," says Mom.
sentences.zh: “自己照照镜子。”妈妈说。

sentences.en: "I see one boy," I say. "Where is the girl?"
sentences.zh: “我只看到一个男孩。”我说，“女孩在哪儿呢？”

sentences.en: Then I hear a laugh near the door.
sentences.zh: 这时候，我听见门边传来笑声。

sentences.en: A girl comes out. "My name is Lily!"
sentences.zh: 一个女孩跳了出来。“我叫 Lily！”

sentences.en: Now we look in the mirror. One boy, one girl.
sentences.zh: 现在我们一起照镜子。一个男孩，一个女孩。

sentences.en: "No one is missing," we say. "Look at me!"
sentences.zh: “谁也不见啦，”我们说。“快看我们！”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! I am a boy. And you?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Two boys and one girl. Well done!
dialogue.zh: 两个男孩和一个女孩。真棒！

sentences.en: What color is the balloon?
sentences.zh: 气球是什么颜色？

sentences.en: It's red.
sentences.zh: 是红色的。

sentences.en: Let's spell the word.
sentences.zh: 我们来拼单词。

sentences.en: Which color do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪种颜色？

sentences.en: Hello, colors!
sentences.zh: 你好，颜色！

frames.hint: 指着一样东西，说出它的颜色

sentences.en: Look! I have three balloons.
sentences.zh: 瞧！我有三个气球。

sentences.en: One is red. One is yellow. One is blue.
sentences.zh: 一个是红的，一个是黄的，一个是蓝的。

sentences.en: "What color do you like?" I ask Ben.
sentences.zh: “你喜欢什么颜色？”我问 Ben。

sentences.en: "I like blue," says Ben. "Can I have it?"
sentences.zh: “我喜欢蓝色，”Ben 说，“能给我吗？”

sentences.en: Ben runs with the blue balloon, and it goes up.
sentences.zh: Ben 抱着蓝气球跑起来，气球却飞上了天。

sentences.en: It is in the tree now. I can not get it.
sentences.zh: 气球挂到树上了，我怎么也够不着。

sentences.en: "Get it down, please!" I ask a bird.
sentences.zh: “帮我拿下来好不好？”我问一只小鸟。

sentences.en: The bird flies up and pushes the balloon.
sentences.zh: 小鸟飞上去，用力一推。

sentences.en: The balloon comes down on my head!
sentences.zh: 气球“啪”地落到我头上！

sentences.en: "Thank you!" I say. "I love blue!"
sentences.zh: “谢谢你！”我说，“蓝色真好！”

sentences.en: Hello, colors! I love you all!
sentences.zh: 你好呀，颜色们！我爱你们！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: And this one? Yellow or blue?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: It is yellow. Let us spell the word. Y-E-L-L-O-W.
dialogue.zh: 它是黄色。我们来拼单词。Y-E-L-L-O-W。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: I like blue too! Find something blue!
dialogue.zh: 我也喜欢蓝色！找个蓝色的东西！

sentences.en: What color do blue and yellow make?
sentences.zh: 蓝色和黄色变成什么颜色？

sentences.en: Blue and yellow make green.
sentences.zh: 蓝色加黄色变成绿色。

sentences.en: What color is it?
sentences.zh: 它是什么颜色？

sentences.en: It's green.
sentences.zh: 是绿色的。

sentences.en: I like orange.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢橙色。

frames.hint: 两种颜色混在一起，会变成什么？

sentences.en: The rain stops. A rainbow is in the sky.
sentences.zh: 雨停了，天上挂着一道彩虹。

sentences.en: "Look at that rainbow!" says Mia.
sentences.zh: “快看那道彩虹！”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "I want a rainbow too," I say.
sentences.zh: “我也想要一道彩虹。”我说。

sentences.en: But I have only red, yellow and blue.
sentences.zh: 可我手里只有红、黄、蓝三种颜色。

sentences.en: "What color do blue and yellow make?" asks Mia.
sentences.zh: “蓝色和黄色能变成什么颜色？”Mia 问。

sentences.en: "Blue and yellow make green," I say.
sentences.zh: “蓝色加黄色就变成绿色。”我说。

sentences.en: "Red and blue make purple!" Mia says.
sentences.zh: “红色加蓝色会变成紫色！”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "Red and yellow make orange," I say.
sentences.zh: “红色加黄色就变成橙色。”我说。

sentences.en: Now I can make every color I want.
sentences.zh: 现在我想变出什么颜色都行。

sentences.en: I draw a big rainbow for Mia.
sentences.zh: 我给 Mia 画了一道大大的彩虹。

sentences.en: "Hello, rainbow!" Mia says. "You are big!"
sentences.zh: “你好呀，彩虹！”Mia 说，“你好大呀！”

sentences.en: "Hello, rainbow!" we say, and laugh.
sentences.zh: “你好呀，彩虹！”我们一起喊，然后都笑了。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: What colors can you see in the rainbow?
dialogue.zh: 你在彩虹里能看到哪些颜色？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! Now let us meet some new colors.
dialogue.zh: 对！现在我们来认识一些新颜色。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Look! Blue and yellow... What color do blue and yellow make?
dialogue.zh: 看！蓝色和黄色……蓝色和黄色变成什么颜色？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! Blue and yellow make green.
dialogue.zh: 对！蓝色加黄色变成绿色。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: What color do yellow and red make?
dialogue.zh: 黄色和红色变成什么颜色？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: What color is it? It is purple! Which color do you like?
dialogue.zh: 它是什么颜色？是紫色！你喜欢哪种颜色？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Me too! You are a color master!
dialogue.zh: 我也是！你是颜色小达人！

sentences.en: Can you say hello to our friends?
sentences.zh: 你能跟朋友们打招呼吗？

sentences.en: Hello! My name is …
sentences.zh: 你好！我叫……

sentences.en: What's your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Are you a boy or a girl?
sentences.zh: 你是男孩还是女孩？

sentences.en: What color is number …?
sentences.zh: 数字几是什么颜色？

sentences.en: Today I go to a new school.
sentences.zh: 今天我来到一所新学校。

sentences.en: I can not find my room.
sentences.zh: 我找不到自己的教室啦。

sentences.en: My hands are cold, but I walk in.
sentences.zh: 我的手心凉凉的，可我还是走了进去。

sentences.en: "Hello! My name is Emma," I say.
sentences.zh: “你好！我叫 Emma。”我说。

sentences.en: "Hello, Emma! My name is Tom."
sentences.zh: “你好，Emma！我叫 Tom。”

sentences.en: "Are you a boy or a girl?" he asks.
sentences.zh: “你是男孩还是女孩？”他问。

sentences.en: "I am a girl," I say, and smile.
sentences.zh: “我是女孩。”我笑着说。

sentences.en: "What color is your bag?" he asks.
sentences.zh: “你的书包是什么颜色？”他问。

sentences.en: "It is blue," I say, and show my bag.
sentences.zh: “是蓝色的。”我举起书包给他看。

sentences.en: "Come with me," says Tom. "Your room is here."
sentences.zh: “跟我来，”Tom 说，“你的教室在这儿。”

sentences.en: "Hello, Emma!" says a girl named Lily.
sentences.zh: “你好，Emma！”一个叫 Lily 的女孩说。

sentences.en: "I am Lily. We are friends now!"
sentences.zh: “我叫 Lily。我们现在是朋友啦！”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Can you say hello to our friends?
dialogue.zh: 你能跟朋友们打招呼吗？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.zh: 你能问问他们的名字吗？

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: Hello! My name is Leo. What's your name?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我叫 Leo。你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Are you a boy or a girl?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: All correct! You passed the quiz!

sentences.en: Let's count.
sentences.zh: 我们来数数。

sentences.en: What number is missing?
sentences.zh: 哪个数字不见了？

sentences.en: Five is missing.
sentences.zh: 五不见了。

sentences.en: Count and Match.
sentences.zh: 数一数，连一连。

sentences.en: Put the numbers in order.
sentences.zh: 把数字排好顺序。

sentences.en: "Let's count!" says Mom.
sentences.zh: “我们来数数！”妈妈说。

sentences.en: We put apples in a big box.
sentences.zh: 我们把苹果放进一个大盒子里。

sentences.en: "One apple, two apples, three apples," I say.
sentences.zh: “一个苹果、两个苹果、三个苹果。”我说。

sentences.en: "And four, and five," says Mom.
sentences.zh: “还有四个、五个。”妈妈说。

sentences.en: We look in the box, but one is missing.
sentences.zh: 我们往盒子里一看，少了一个。

sentences.en: "What number is missing?" I ask.
sentences.zh: “少的是哪个数呢？”我问。

sentences.en: "Five," says Mom. "One apple is not here."
sentences.zh: “五，”妈妈说，“少了一个苹果。”

sentences.en: Then Mom points to the table.
sentences.zh: 这时妈妈指了指桌子。

sentences.en: The cat is under the table with it!
sentences.zh: 原来小猫就在桌子底下，嘴里还叼着它！

sentences.en: Now I count one, two, three, four, five!
sentences.zh: 现在我数：一个、两个、三个、四个、五个！

sentences.en: "Good cat! Give me the apple," I say.
sentences.zh: “好猫咪！把苹果给我。”我说。

sentences.en: We count the apples again and eat them all.
sentences.zh: 我们又数了一遍苹果，然后一起吃掉了。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! Five is missing. Show me five fingers!
dialogue.zh: 对！五不见了。给我看五根手指！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Count and match. Two apples for number two!
dialogue.zh: 数一数，连一连。两个苹果连二号！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: You can count to five. Amazing!
dialogue.zh: 你能数到五了。太厉害了！

songs.zh: 一 二 三 四 五

sentences.en: How many frogs are there?
sentences.zh: 有几只青蛙？

sentences.en: Fill in the missing numbers.
sentences.zh: 填上缺少的数字。

sentences.en: How many animals are there?
sentences.zh: 有几只动物？

sentences.en: 1 comes before it.
sentences.zh: 1在它前面。

sentences.en: 3 comes after it.
sentences.zh: 3在它后面。

frames.hint: 排好顺序，说说谁排在后面

sentences.en: We go to the zoo today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们去了动物园。

sentences.en: "How many frogs are there?" I ask.
sentences.zh: “那里有多少只青蛙？”我问。

sentences.en: "Six frogs," says Tom. "Look at the water!"
sentences.zh: “六只青蛙，”Tom 说，“快看水里！”

sentences.en: Seven birds sit in the tree.
sentences.zh: 七只小鸟坐在树上。

sentences.en: Eight fish swim in the water.
sentences.zh: 八条鱼在水里游来游去。

sentences.en: I count nine cats near the door.
sentences.zh: 我数到门边有九只猫。

sentences.en: Ten ducks walk on the road.
sentences.zh: 十只小鸭子在路上走。

sentences.en: "Count them all again!" says Mom.
sentences.zh: “再数一遍！”妈妈说。

sentences.en: "What number is missing?" I ask Mom.
sentences.zh: “少了哪个数呢？”我问妈妈。

sentences.en: "Ten," says Mom. "One duck walked away."
sentences.zh: “十，”妈妈说，“有一只鸭子走远了。”

sentences.en: We look down the road. One duck comes back!
sentences.zh: 我们顺着路看过去，那只鸭子又回来了！

sentences.en: Now I know my numbers from six to ten!
sentences.zh: 现在我从六到十的数字全都认识啦！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: You know one to five. Now let us learn more!
dialogue.zh: 你已经会一到五了。现在学更多！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Can you count one more time?

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: Six, seven, eight, nine and ten!

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Perfect! You know all the numbers!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！你认识所有数字了！

songs.zh: 一 二 三 四 五

songs.en: one two three four six five
one two three four six seven five
one two three four six seven eight five
songs.zh: 一二三四五六七八九是

songs.en: one two three four six seven nine five eight
I Say, You Tick ten one two three four six seven nine five eight
songs.zh: 我说，你勾十一二三四六七九五八

songs.en: For example, if you see this
Six, seven, eight, nine and ten.
Can you count one more time?

sentences.en: Hello, dog!
sentences.zh: 你好，小狗！

sentences.en: Mom, it's a dog!
sentences.zh: 妈妈，这是一只狗！

sentences.en: Yes, it's so cute.
sentences.zh: 是的，它真可爱。

sentences.en: Which pet do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪个宠物？

sentences.en: I like the cat.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢猫。

sentences.en: The cat sits in the yard and waits.
sentences.zh: 小猫咪坐在院子里，静静等着。

sentences.en: A small white dog comes and stops.
sentences.zh: 一只白色小狗走了过来，停下脚步。

sentences.en: "Hello! I am a new pet," says the dog.
sentences.zh: “你好！我是一只新来的小宠物。”小狗说。

sentences.en: "Can I live with you?" asks Lily.
sentences.zh: “你能和我们一起住吗？”Lily 问。

sentences.en: "Yes! But I am very hungry," says the dog.
sentences.zh: “好呀！不过我的肚子好饿。”小狗说。

sentences.en: Lily puts her food down and opens a big box.
sentences.zh: Lily 放下食物，又打开一个大盒子。

sentences.en: A rabbit hops out and says, "Hello!"
sentences.zh: 一只小兔子蹦了出来：“你好！”

sentences.en: Then a little hamster runs out too.
sentences.zh: 接着，一只小仓鼠也跑了出来。

sentences.en: A bird flies down and eats with them.
sentences.zh: 一只小鸟飞下来，和大家一起吃。

sentences.en: "Come and eat with me," says the cat.
sentences.zh: “快来和我一起吃吧。”小猫说。

sentences.en: Now the dog has four new friends.
sentences.zh: 现在小狗多了四个新朋友。

sentences.en: "Hello, new pets! We are five pets now."
sentences.zh: “你好呀，新伙伴们！我们现在有五只宠物啦。”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: A cat! I like cats too. They are so cute!
dialogue.zh: 一只猫！我也喜欢猫。它们真可爱！

sentences.en: What's this animal?
sentences.zh: 这是什么动物？

sentences.en: This is a cow.
sentences.zh: 这是一头奶牛。

sentences.en: What does the cow say?
sentences.zh: 奶牛怎么叫？

sentences.en: Moo, moo!
sentences.zh: 哞，哞！

sentences.en: Hello, pig!
sentences.zh: 你好，小猪！

sentences.en: A little duck walks on the farm today.
sentences.zh: 今天，小鸭子一个人在农场上走着。

sentences.en: She can not find her family.
sentences.zh: 它找不到自己的家人了。

sentences.en: "Hello, duck! Where is your family?" asks the cow.
sentences.zh: “你好呀，小鸭子！你的家人在哪儿？”奶牛问。

sentences.en: "I do not know," says the duck.
sentences.zh: “我不知道……”小鸭子说。

sentences.en: The big pig does not help. It eats an apple.
sentences.zh: 大猪也帮不上忙，它正忙着啃苹果。

sentences.en: Then a white chicken comes to the duck.
sentences.zh: 这时，一只白母鸡走到小鸭子身边。

sentences.en: "I saw them near the old tree," says the chicken.
sentences.zh: “我在老树那边看见它们了。”母鸡说。

sentences.en: The duck runs and looks behind it.
sentences.zh: 小鸭子跑过去，往树后一看。

sentences.en: Her family is there! They all say, "Hello!"
sentences.zh: 家人都到齐了！它们一起喊：“你好！”

sentences.en: The cow, the pig and the chicken come too.
sentences.zh: 奶牛、大猪和母鸡也赶来了。

sentences.en: The animals stand together in the sun.
sentences.zh: 动物们站在太阳底下，挤成一团。

sentences.en: "Hello, family! Here you are," says the duck.
sentences.zh: “你好呀，家人！我找到你们啦。”小鸭子说。

sentences.en: Let's go to the zoo!
sentences.zh: 我们去动物园吧！

sentences.en: What animal do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到什么动物？

sentences.en: I see a panda.
sentences.zh: 我看到一只熊猫。

sentences.en: What animals do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到哪些动物？

sentences.en: Name the animals.
sentences.zh: 说出动物的名字。

sentences.en: A new panda comes to the zoo.
sentences.zh: 一只新来的熊猫走进动物园。

sentences.en: He is big, but he does not come out.
sentences.zh: 它很大，却总是不肯出来。

sentences.en: He sits in his house and waits.
sentences.zh: 它坐在自己的小屋里，等着谁叫它。

sentences.en: "Come out and play, panda!" says the monkey.
sentences.zh: “出来一起玩吧，熊猫！”猴子说。

sentences.en: "No! I am not ready," says the panda.
sentences.zh: “不要！我还没准备好。”熊猫说。

sentences.en: The monkey climbs a tall tree and looks for him.
sentences.zh: 猴子爬上一棵高高的树，帮它找。

sentences.en: Then a big bear comes and calls him.
sentences.zh: 后来，大熊走过来喊它。

sentences.en: "I am big, but I am kind," says the bear.
sentences.zh: “我虽然大，可是我很善良。”熊说。

sentences.en: A parrot flies down and says, "Hello! I can sing!"
sentences.zh: 一只鹦鹉飞下来：“你好！我会唱歌！”

sentences.en: The panda laughs and comes out of his house.
sentences.zh: 熊猫笑了，从小屋里走了出来。

sentences.en: He jumps and plays with the monkey.
sentences.zh: 它跳呀跳，和猴子玩在一起。

sentences.en: "Hello, new friend! Let's play again!"
sentences.zh: “你好呀，新朋友！我们下次再玩！”

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: I see a bear and a monkey.
dialogue.zh: 我看到一只熊和一只猴子。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: The monkey is very clever. Me too!

sentences.en: Let's go to the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我们去海洋吧。

sentences.en: What's this animal?
sentences.zh: 这是什么动物？

sentences.en: This is a turtle.
sentences.zh: 这是一只海龟。

sentences.en: Swim like a fish.
sentences.zh: 像鱼一样游泳。

sentences.en: Dive like a dolphin.
sentences.zh: 像海豚一样潜水。

sentences.en: A little turtle swims in the big ocean.
sentences.zh: 小海龟在大海里慢慢地游着。

sentences.en: She is slow and can not keep up.
sentences.zh: 它游得慢，怎么也跟不上。

sentences.en: A dolphin jumps and laughs at her.
sentences.zh: 一只海豚跳起来，笑她。

sentences.en: "You are too slow, turtle!" says the dolphin.
sentences.zh: “你太慢啦，小海龟！”海豚说。

sentences.en: The turtle goes away. She feels sad.
sentences.zh: 小海龟游开了，心里有点难过。

sentences.en: Then a small fish comes and says, "Hello!"
sentences.zh: 这时，一条小鱼游过来：“你好！”

sentences.en: A little seahorse is there. "I am lost."
sentences.zh: 那边有一只小海马。“我迷路了。”

sentences.en: "We will take you home," says the turtle.
sentences.zh: “我们送你回家。”小海龟说。

sentences.en: The turtle and the fish help him.
sentences.zh: 小海龟和小鱼一起帮他。

sentences.en: Then the fish shows the turtle how to swim.
sentences.zh: 后来，小鱼教小海龟怎么游泳。

sentences.en: The turtle swims fast now, like a fish.
sentences.zh: 现在小海龟游得可快了，像鱼一样。

sentences.en: The dolphin comes back. "Hello! We can swim together!"
sentences.zh: 海豚又游回来了：“你好！我们一起游吧！”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: A turtle! Swim like a fish!
dialogue.zh: 一只海龟！像鱼一样游泳！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: A seahorse! It is very small. Do you like fish?
dialogue.zh: 海马！它很小。你喜欢鱼吗？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: And you can swim too! Excellent!

sentences.en: They're bugs.
sentences.zh: 它们是虫子。

sentences.en: How many butterflies do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到几只蝴蝶？

sentences.en: I see 3 butterflies.
sentences.zh: 我看到3只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: How many bees do you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到几只蜜蜂？

sentences.en: I see four bees.
sentences.zh: 我看到四只蜜蜂。

sentences.en: A little caterpillar eats a green leaf.
sentences.zh: 一条小毛毛虫在绿叶上吃着东西。

sentences.en: It is small, but it eats and eats.
sentences.zh: 它很小，却一直吃呀吃。

sentences.en: It wants to fly, like a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 它想像蝴蝶一样飞起来。

sentences.en: Kate watches it every day in the yard.
sentences.zh: Kate 每天都在院子里看它。

sentences.en: "Hello! Do you want to fly?" says a bee.
sentences.zh: “你好！你想飞吗？”一只蜜蜂说。

sentences.en: "Eat and get big," says the bee. The caterpillar eats.
sentences.zh: “多吃一点，快快长大。”蜜蜂说。小毛毛虫吃呀吃。

sentences.en: Then a spider comes down from the tree.
sentences.zh: 这时，一只蜘蛛从树上下来了。

sentences.en: "Go behind the leaf!" says the bee. The caterpillar waits.
sentences.zh: “快到叶子后面去！”蜜蜂说。小毛毛虫乖乖等着。

sentences.en: Now the caterpillar comes out and eats and gets big.
sentences.zh: 小毛毛虫又出来啦，一边吃一边长大。

sentences.en: One day it is not on the leaf.
sentences.zh: 有一天，它不在叶子上了。

sentences.en: Kate looks behind the leaf.
sentences.zh: Kate 往叶子后面一看。

sentences.en: "Hello! I am your little bug," says the butterfly.
sentences.zh: “你好！我就是你那条小虫子。”蝴蝶说。

dialogue.zh: 三只蝴蝶！你看到几只蜘蛛？

dialogue.zh: 两只蜘蛛！你看到几只蜜蜂？

dialogue.zh: 嗡嗡嗡！你是虫子小专家！

sentences.en: How many animals are there?
sentences.zh: 有几只动物？

sentences.en: What's this animal?
sentences.zh: 这是什么动物？

sentences.en: It's a dog.
sentences.zh: 这是一只狗。

sentences.zh: 你能在海洋里看到什么动物？

sentences.en: I like cats. It's so cute.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢猫。它真可爱。

sentences.en: Mom gives Leo a book about animals.
sentences.zh: 妈妈给了 Leo 一本讲动物的书。

sentences.en: He knows every animal in the book.
sentences.zh: 书里的动物他全都认识。

sentences.en: "How many animals can you see?" asks Mom.
sentences.zh: “你看见多少只动物？”妈妈问。

sentences.en: Leo counts them all, but one is hard.
sentences.zh: Leo 全都数了出来，可有一题很难。

sentences.en: "What animal lives in the ocean?" Leo asks.
sentences.zh: “什么动物住在海洋里？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: They go to the ocean, and the cat comes too.
sentences.zh: 他们去海边看海，小猫也跟着一起来了。

sentences.en: One dolphin jumps in the water.
sentences.zh: 一只海豚跳出水面。

sentences.en: "One! Now count the fish," says Leo.
sentences.zh: “一只！Leo，现在数数鱼吧。”Leo 说。

sentences.en: Leo counts two, three, four and five.
sentences.zh: Leo 数着：两条、三条、四条、五条。

sentences.en: The cat counts them too and laughs.
sentences.zh: 小猫也跟着数，笑出了声。

sentences.en: "Now you know all the answers," says Mom.
sentences.zh: “现在你全都答对啦。”妈妈说。

sentences.en: "Hello, Mom! The cat is my pet. It is so cute."
sentences.zh: “你好呀，妈妈！小猫是我的宠物，它太可爱啦。”

sentences.en: How many legs does a dog have?
sentences.zh: 狗有几条腿？

sentences.en: 4 plus 4 equals 8.
sentences.zh: 4加4等于8。

sentences.en: How many legs do they have altogether?
sentences.zh: 它们总共有几条腿？

sentences.en: They have 8 legs altogether.
sentences.zh: 它们总共有8条腿。

sentences.zh: 算一算再说句子。

frames.hint: 算一算，再把整句读出来

sentences.en: Ben and Anna sit on the grass.
sentences.zh: Ben 和 Anna 坐在草地上。

sentences.en: A dog comes and looks at them.
sentences.zh: 一只狗走过来，看着他们。

sentences.en: "How many legs do you have?" asks Ben.
sentences.zh: “你有几条腿？”Ben 问。

sentences.en: "I have four legs," says the dog.
sentences.zh: “我有四条腿。”狗说。

sentences.en: A cat comes too. It has four legs.
sentences.zh: 一只猫也来了，它有四条腿。

sentences.en: Now a bird and a duck come to play.
sentences.zh: 这时，一只鸟和一只鸭子也来玩。

sentences.en: The bird has two legs. The duck has two.
sentences.zh: 鸟有两条腿，鸭子也有两条。

sentences.en: "4 plus 4 equals 8," says Ben.
sentences.zh: “4 加 4 等于 8。”Ben 说。

sentences.en: "And 2 plus 2 makes 4," says Anna.
sentences.zh: “那 2 加 2 就是 4。”Anna 说。

sentences.en: "How many legs do they have altogether?" asks Anna.
sentences.zh: “它们一共有多少条腿？”Anna 问。

sentences.en: "12 legs! That is hard addition," says Ben.
sentences.zh: “12 条腿！这道加法好难。”Ben 说。

sentences.en: The dog jumps. "Hello! We did it!"
sentences.zh: 小狗跳了起来：“你好！我们算出来啦！”

sentences.en: What comes next?
sentences.zh: 下一个是什么？

sentences.en: The cat comes next.
sentences.zh: 下一个是猫。

sentences.en: It's a pattern.
sentences.zh: 这是一个规律。

sentences.en: Can you read the pattern?
sentences.zh: 你能读出这个规律吗？

sentences.en: Let's finish the patterns.
sentences.zh: 我们来完成规律。

frames.hint: 找出规律，说说下一个是谁

sentences.en: Jack puts his toy animals on the table.
sentences.zh: Jack 把玩具动物一个一个摆在桌上。

sentences.en: Cat, dog, cat, dog. It is a pattern.
sentences.zh: 猫、狗、猫、狗——这是一个规律。

sentences.en: "What comes next?" asks Jack.
sentences.zh: “下一个是什么？”Jack 问。

sentences.en: The cat comes next, and then the dog.
sentences.zh: 下一个是猫，然后才是狗。

sentences.en: "I can finish it," says Jack.
sentences.zh: “我能把它排完。”Jack 说。

sentences.en: But one animal is missing from the table.
sentences.zh: 可是桌上少了一个动物。

sentences.en: Jack looks in the box and under the bed.
sentences.zh: Jack 在盒子里、床上都找过了。

sentences.en: The little dog is not there.
sentences.zh: 小狗狗不见了。

sentences.en: Then a big dog comes and sits next to the cat.
sentences.zh: 这时，一只大狗走进来，坐在小猫旁边。

sentences.en: "Now the pattern is here!" says Jack.
sentences.zh: “现在规律齐啦！”Jack 说。

sentences.en: The dog comes next. Then the cat comes too.
sentences.zh: 下一个是狗，然后猫也来了。

sentences.en: "Hello! What comes next?" asks the dog.
sentences.zh: “你好！下一个是什么？”小狗问。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Cat, dog, cat, dog... what comes next?
dialogue.zh: 猫、狗、猫、狗……下一个是什么？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! The cat comes next. It is a pattern.
dialogue.zh: 对！下一个是猫。这是一个规律。

dialogue.en: What comes next? The yellow leaf or the green leaf?
dialogue.zh: 下一个是什么？黄叶还是绿叶？

dialogue.en: A boy, a girl, a boy, a girl... it is a pattern!
dialogue.zh: 男孩、女孩、男孩、女孩……这是个规律！

sentences.zh: 你好，苹果！

sentences.zh: 它是什么？

sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪种水果？

sentences.en: I like grapes.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢葡萄。

sentences.en: Hello! I am Mia. I have a big bag.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Mia。我有一个大袋子。

sentences.en: I put an apple, a peach and grapes in it.
sentences.zh: 我把一个苹果、一个桃子和一些葡萄放了进去。

sentences.en: A big watermelon is in it.
sentences.zh: 里面还放着一个大西瓜。

sentences.en: My bag is too big. I can not carry it.
sentences.zh: 我的袋子太大了，我拿不动它。

sentences.en: A little monkey comes and looks at my bag.
sentences.zh: 一只小猴子走过来，盯着我的袋子看。

sentences.en: "Hello, Mia! Which fruit do you like?"
sentences.zh: “你好呀，Mia！你喜欢哪种水果？”

sentences.en: "I like grapes. Do you like the watermelon?"
sentences.zh: “我喜欢葡萄。你喜欢西瓜吗？”

sentences.en: "Yes! I want that big watermelon," says the monkey.
sentences.zh: “喜欢！我想要那个大西瓜。”猴子说。

sentences.en: We sit down and eat the watermelon together.
sentences.zh: 我们坐下来，一起吃西瓜。

sentences.en: The watermelon is cold and good.
sentences.zh: 西瓜又凉又好吃。

sentences.en: "Hello, watermelon! You are so good!"
sentences.zh: “你好呀，西瓜！你真好吃！”

sentences.en: The bag is small now. I can carry it home.
sentences.zh: 现在袋子变小了，我拎得动它回家了。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Hello, watermelon! Hello, peach! Hello, grapes!
dialogue.zh: 你好，西瓜！你好，桃子！你好，葡萄！

dialogue.zh: 一天一苹果，医生远离我！

sentences.zh: 这是什么水果？

sentences.en: It's a red cherry.
sentences.zh: 它是一颗红樱桃。

sentences.en: It's a yellow banana.
sentences.zh: 它是一根黄香蕉。

sentences.en: What color is it?
sentences.zh: 它是什么颜色？

sentences.zh: 我喜欢香蕉。

sentences.en: Hello! I am Ben. Today I open my box.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Ben。今天我打开了我的盒子。

sentences.en: "What is this? It is a red cherry."
sentences.zh: “这是什么？是一颗红红的樱桃。”

sentences.en: It is small. I eat it and smile.
sentences.zh: 它小小的。我咬一口，笑了。

sentences.en: Then I find a long yellow banana.
sentences.zh: 接着我又摸到一根长长的黄香蕉。

sentences.en: "Wow! My box has fruit for two!"
sentences.zh: “哇！我的盒子里有两人份的水果！”

sentences.en: Leo comes and sits down with me.
sentences.zh: Leo 走过来，在我身边坐下。

sentences.en: "Look! A big orange and a red strawberry."
sentences.zh: “快看！一个大橙子，还有一颗红草莓。”

sentences.en: "Can I have the strawberry?" asks Leo.
sentences.zh: “我可以吃那颗草莓吗？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: "Yes! Here you are," I say and give it to him.
sentences.zh: “当然可以！给你。”我把它递给他。

sentences.en: We eat the fruit and laugh together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起吃水果，一起笑。

sentences.en: Now my box is empty, but I am happy.
sentences.zh: 现在盒子空空的，可我心里美滋滋的。

sentences.en: "Hello, fruit! I will bring you more."
sentences.zh: “你好呀，水果！明天我还要带更多来。”

dialogue.zh: 它是一根黄香蕉。你喜欢草莓吗？

dialogue.zh: 红樱桃，可爱的樱桃，我喜欢樱桃！

reading.title: What Would You Like to Drink?

sentences.en: Hello! I am Lily. I run home from school.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Lily。我从学校跑回家。

sentences.en: I am thirsty. My mouth is dry.
sentences.zh: 我好渴，嘴巴干干的。

sentences.en: "What would you like to drink?" asks Mom.
sentences.zh: “你想喝点什么呀？”妈妈问。

sentences.en: "I would like some juice, please."
sentences.zh: “我想喝点果汁，谢谢。”

sentences.en: "Let's make four fruit drinks," says Dad.
sentences.zh: “我们来做四杯水果饮料吧。”爸爸说。

sentences.en: We wash apples and put them in a big cup.
sentences.zh: 我们把苹果洗一洗，全放进大杯子里。

sentences.en: Now we have juice, milk, soda and water.
sentences.zh: 现在桌上有果汁、牛奶、汽水，还有水。

sentences.en: I drink the juice. It is cold and good.
sentences.zh: 我喝着果汁，凉凉的，真好喝。

sentences.en: Then my friends come and ask for a drink.
sentences.zh: 这时候朋友们来了，也想喝点什么。

sentences.en: "We have four," I say. "Take one each!"
sentences.zh: “我们有四杯呢，”我说，“一人一杯！”

sentences.en: We all drink and we all smile.
sentences.zh: 大家都喝着，都笑起来了。

sentences.en: "Now I know what I want to drink!"
sentences.zh: “现在我知道自己想喝什么啦！”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Milk! It comes from cows. It is white.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶！它来自奶牛。它是白色的。

sentences.en: I want broccoli.
sentences.zh: 我要西兰花。

sentences.en: Shopping List: broccoli, potato…
sentences.zh: 购物清单：西兰花、土豆……

sentences.en: "Do you know these vegetables?" asks Mom.
sentences.zh: “你认识这些蔬菜吗？”妈妈问。

sentences.en: A big box is at our door this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，一个大箱子放在我们家门口。

sentences.en: "What colors are they?" I ask Mom.
sentences.zh: “它们都是什么颜色的？”我问妈妈。

sentences.en: "Green broccoli and a red tomato!"
sentences.zh: “绿色的西兰花，还有一个红番茄！”

sentences.en: "I do not like vegetables," says Tom.
sentences.zh: “我不爱吃蔬菜。”Tom 说。

sentences.en: I wash all of them very clean.
sentences.zh: 我把这些蔬菜全都洗得干干净净。

sentences.en: Mom puts a potato and celery in the soup.
sentences.zh: 妈妈把土豆和芹菜放进汤里。

sentences.en: The soup is hot and it looks so good.
sentences.zh: 这汤又热腾腾的，看着就好香。

sentences.en: "Can I try one cup?" asks Tom.
sentences.zh: “我能尝一杯吗？”Tom 问。

sentences.en: "Yes! Take a little," says Mom.
sentences.zh: “行呀！少盛一点。”妈妈说。

sentences.en: Tom eats the soup and the celery.
sentences.zh: Tom 把汤和芹菜都吃了。

sentences.en: "Mom, now I like vegetables," says Tom.
sentences.zh: “妈妈，我现在爱吃蔬菜了。”Tom 说。

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: Broccoli is green. The potato is brown.
dialogue.zh: 西兰花是绿色的。土豆是棕色的。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: I want a tomato. And you?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Shopping list: broccoli, potato, tomato, celery. Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 购物清单：西兰花、土豆、番茄、芹菜。还有别的吗？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Milk is not a vegetable, but okay!
dialogue.zh: 牛奶不是蔬菜，不过也好！

sentences.en: These are carrots.
sentences.zh: 这些是胡萝卜。

sentences.en: Do you like vegetables?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢蔬菜吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我不喜欢。

sentences.en: I like carrots.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢胡萝卜。

sentences.en: Hello! I am Anna. I am hungry now.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Anna。我现在饿了。

sentences.en: Mom gives me a big green salad.
sentences.zh: 妈妈端给我一大盘绿绿的沙拉。

sentences.en: "Do you like vegetables?" she asks.
sentences.zh: “你喜欢吃蔬菜吗？”她问。

sentences.en: "No, I don't. I only like fruit."
sentences.zh: “不喜欢。我只爱吃水果。”

sentences.en: I look at the salad. It has lettuce and cucumber.
sentences.zh: 我看着这盘沙拉：里面有生菜，还有黄瓜。

sentences.en: And there is one small bean in it.
sentences.zh: 还有一颗小小的豆子。

sentences.en: "Just one try," says Mom. I try a carrot.
sentences.zh: “就尝一口嘛。”妈妈说。我咬了一根胡萝卜。

sentences.en: The carrot is cold and good.
sentences.zh: 胡萝卜脆脆的，还挺好吃的。

sentences.en: Then I try a bean and some cucumber.
sentences.zh: 接着我又尝了豆子和黄瓜。

sentences.en: Now I eat all the salad!
sentences.zh: 现在我把整盘沙拉都吃光啦！

sentences.en: "Yes, I do! I like vegetables," I say.
sentences.zh: “喜欢呀！我爱蔬菜。”我说。

sentences.en: "Can I have more carrots?" I ask Mom.
sentences.zh: “我能再要点胡萝卜吗？”我问妈妈。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: These are beans. Do you like vegetables?
dialogue.zh: 这些是豆子。你喜欢蔬菜吗？

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Carrots are good for your eyes!

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: I want to eat carrots every day!

sentences.en: What fruit do you like?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢什么水果？

sentences.en: I like apples.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢苹果。

sentences.en: Do you like vegetables?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢蔬菜吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢。/ 不，我不喜欢。

sentences.en: What drinks would you like to drink?
sentences.zh: 你想喝什么饮料？

sentences.en: Hello! Today we play a big food game.
sentences.zh: 你好！今天我们要玩一场食物大问答。

sentences.en: Mom puts a box of food on the table.
sentences.zh: 妈妈把一盒吃的放在桌子上。

sentences.en: "The one with the most answers takes it," says Mom.
sentences.zh: “答得最多的人，抱走这盒吃的。”妈妈说。

sentences.en: "What fruit do you like?" I ask Ben.
sentences.zh: “你喜欢什么水果？”我问 Ben。

sentences.en: "I like apples and grapes," says Ben.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢苹果和葡萄。”Ben 说。

sentences.en: "Do you like every vegetable?" I ask Tom.
sentences.zh: “每一种蔬菜你都爱吃吗？”我问 Tom。

sentences.en: "I like carrots," says Tom.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢胡萝卜。”Tom 说。

sentences.en: "What is four plus two?" asks Leo.
sentences.zh: “四加二等于多少？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: "Six is equal to four plus two!"
sentences.zh: “六就等于四加二！”

sentences.en: Leo knows all the answers. He is so happy.
sentences.zh: Leo 什么都答得上来，他高兴极了。

sentences.en: "But we share it, one for you, one for me."
sentences.zh: “可是我们分着吃，一人一份。”

sentences.en: "Now we all have food and a drink."
sentences.zh: “现在大家都有吃的，还有喝的啦。”

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: What drinks would you like to drink?

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: Yes, I do. I like fruit and vegetables!
dialogue.zh: 是的，我喜欢。我喜欢水果和蔬菜！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Quiz done! You did very well!
dialogue.zh: 测验结束！你做得非常好！

sentences.en: What do you want?
sentences.zh: 你想要什么？

sentences.en: I want chips.
sentences.zh: 我要薯片。

sentences.en: What does 4 plus 2 equal?
sentences.zh: 4加2等于多少？

sentences.en: What is missing?
sentences.zh: 什么不见了？

sentences.en: Abracadabra!
sentences.zh: 阿布拉卡达布拉！

frames.hint: 问小朋友想吃什么零食

sentences.en: Hello! I am Leo. I am hungry now.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Leo。我现在饿坏了。

sentences.en: Mom puts five snacks in a big box.
sentences.zh: 妈妈往大盒子里装了五份零食。

sentences.en: I see chips, a lollipop and a marshmallow.
sentences.zh: 我看见薯片、一根棒棒糖，还有一颗棉花糖。

sentences.en: "What a nice snack box!" I say.
sentences.zh: “多好的零食盒子呀！”我说。

sentences.en: Then I look in the box again.
sentences.zh: 接着我又低头看了看盒子。

sentences.en: Where is my gummy bear? It is not here.
sentences.zh: 我的小熊软糖在哪儿？它不在这里。

sentences.en: I look under the table and the chair.
sentences.zh: 我看了桌子底下，也看了椅子底下。

sentences.en: A little mouse runs out with it!
sentences.zh: 一只小老鼠叼着它跑了出来！

sentences.en: "Hello! Do you want the lollipop?" I ask.
sentences.zh: “你好！你想要这根棒棒糖吗？”我问。

sentences.en: The mouse takes it and gives back the bear.
sentences.zh: 小老鼠接过棒棒糖，又把软糖还给我。

sentences.en: Now I have five snacks for my friends.
sentences.zh: 现在我又凑齐五份零食，分给朋友们。

sentences.en: "Bye bye, little mouse! See you tomorrow."
sentences.zh: “再见啦，小老鼠！明天见。”

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: Yes! I want lollipops and gummy bears!
dialogue.zh: 想要！我要棒棒糖和小熊软糖！

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yummy! But not too many snacks, okay?
dialogue.zh: 美味！但零食不能吃太多，好吗？

sentences.en: What do you want?
sentences.zh: 你想要什么？

sentences.en: I want popcorn.
sentences.zh: 我要爆米花。

sentences.en: I want nuts and candies.
sentences.zh: 我要坚果和糖果。

sentences.en: Do you want these?
sentences.zh: 你想要这些吗？

sentences.en: What are they?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么？

sentences.en: Hello! I am Grace. I want a snack.
sentences.zh: 你好！我是 Grace。我想吃点零食。

sentences.en: Mom makes popcorn. It is hot and good.
sentences.zh: 妈妈做了爆米花，热乎乎的，真香。

sentences.en: She puts candy, a jelly bean and a nut in my bag.
sentences.zh: 她往我包里放糖果、果冻豆，还有一颗坚果。

sentences.en: My bunny comes. "What do you want?" she asks.
sentences.zh: 我的小兔子来了。“你想要什么呀？”她问。

sentences.en: "I want popcorn," I say. We sit on the grass.
sentences.zh: “我想吃爆米花。”我说。我们在草地上坐下。

sentences.en: Then the bunny takes my candy!
sentences.zh: 结果小兔子把我的糖果叼走了！

sentences.en: "Oh no! I want that candy too," I say.
sentences.zh: “哎呀！那我也想吃糖果呀。”我说。

sentences.en: "We can share it," says the bunny.
sentences.zh: “我们可以分着吃呀。”小兔子说。

sentences.en: Now we have one candy each.
sentences.zh: 现在我们一人一颗糖果。

sentences.en: The popcorn is hot, and I like it.
sentences.zh: 爆米花热热的，我特别爱吃。

sentences.en: "What do you want?" I ask again.
sentences.zh: “你想要什么呀？”我又问了一遍。

sentences.en: "I want a friend," says the bunny.
sentences.zh: “我想要一个朋友。”小兔子说。

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Guess! They are sweet and colorful.

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Yes! Candy. What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: I want nuts and candies. And you?

dialogue.speaker: T
dialogue.en: Say it faster and faster! I want popcorn!
dialogue.zh: 说得越来越快！我要爆米花！

dialogue.speaker: S
dialogue.en: I want popcorn! I want popcorn!
dialogue.zh: 我要爆米花！我要爆米花！
